title: Procedure for moving controlled substance stock between licensed pharmacies
rule_summary: A licensee, Manager of Record or agent intending to transfer Schedules II through VI from one Board-licensed pharmacy to another shall notify the Board IN WRITING BY CERTIFIED MAIL at least 14 days before the transfer, unless otherwise authorized, giving the named particulars of both pharmacies. No sooner than 14 days after notification the transfer may proceed provided that on the transfer date the transferor takes a complete inventory of all Schedule II through V substances and all Schedule VI substances reportable to the prescription monitoring program; both Managers of Record sign the inventory report, with a staff pharmacist permitted to sign in place of an unavailable transferor Manager on notice to the Board of the reason; both pharmacies keep a readily retrievable copy for at least two years; both file an attestation with the Board within TEN DAYS; the transferee receives the substances and records on the transfer date and keeps the records at least two years; and the transferor MAY NOT POSSESS any controlled substances after the transfer date.
exam_relevance: Tests a multi-step procedure with three different clocks and a closing prohibition candidates routinely miss.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

numeric_facts.fact: Notice to the Board before transferring controlled substances
numeric_facts.conditions: in writing by certified mail, unless otherwise authorized

numeric_facts.fact: Attestation to the Board confirming the inventory
numeric_facts.conditions: after the transfer, filed by both pharmacies

numeric_facts.fact: Retention of the controlled substance inventory report

exceptions: A staff pharmacist may sign where the transferor Manager of Record is unavailable due to death, serious illness or termination, on notice to the Board
common_confusions: Confusing the 14-day notice with the 10-day attestation
Assuming the transferor may retain a small residual stock after the transfer date
Assuming only Schedules II through V are inventoried, when reportable Schedule VI is included
